I am here in Mbeya, and the rains come well on our side, so maize grows nicely if I tend it right. My plot is small, only a small piece, but I own it and I plant beans together with the maize like I always do. I went to school a little, so I know fertilizer helps, and last season I put one small share of urea and got a decent harvest — I will do the same this year, maybe topdress once when the maize is knee-high. I cannot afford improved seed every year, but I kept some good seed from last harvest and I will buy a small tin of improved seed from the agro-dealer to mix in. No irrigation here, I wait for the rains; the work I do myself with my wife, and maybe I call one or two people for weeding when the grass is thick.
